name: Harris Thermal Transfer Products (V2)
notes: Second Harris Thermal site, staged at ht2.demo.webriculture.com on 2026-09-03 for the client's 'web developer review'. Distinct from `harristhermal` (the July 2026 WordPress-scrape port on ht.demo.webriculture.com) — leave that one alone. SOURCE OF TRUTH is the client's Eleventy project at examples/harris/harris-thermal-website (frozen Wave 6.6, commit d098e22 on branch wave-5-forms-content; read its README.md and CURRENT-PROJECT-STATUS.md first). Nothing under pages/ or public/sites/harristhermal2/ is hand-edited: docs/import.sh rebuilds the Eleventy site with the staging URL and regenerates both wholesale; docs/last-import.txt records what was imported. To update: pull the client's new commit into examples/, re-run docs/import.sh, then php artisan test (the smoke suite renders all 201 pages). Import rewrites root-absolute /assets/ and /wp-content/ to /sites/harristhermal2/... escapes directive-shaped @word tokens as @@word (Blade has an @context directive that collides with JSON-LD keys and 500s every page; @@ renders as @), and injects the platform widgets before </body>; the client's 301 map (config/redirects.csv) is loaded into settings.redirects. Its 21 '410 Gone' rows are served as 404 because SiteHub has no 410 support — decide at launch (add 410 support, or the client's documented fallback of 301 -> /). The footer's 'Development Build: Wave 6.6' marker is intentional for this review build; the client removes it in Wave 7. Wave 7 items SiteHub already covers: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, 404 page. Still open before cutover: (1) forms — contact, quote and employment forms post to themselves by client design (formEndpoint/employmentFormEndpoint empty); SiteHub's forms feature only handles the fixed contact field set, so the quote and employment forms need a provider or a forms-feature extension; (2) image URLs — the client wants /wp-content/uploads/... preserved for image SEO, SiteHub serves them under /sites/harristhermal2/ (platform decision); (3) ht2.demo is the site's PRIMARY domain, so it is indexable — at cutover make harristhermal.com primary (ht2.demo then 301s) and re-import with --url https://harristhermal.com so canonicals/JSON-LD point at production; (4) GA GT-NMLFZCD fires (consent-gated) on the demo host. Post-launch admin tooling plan and pre-cutover checklist: docs/ADMIN-TOOLS-PLAN.md (parked 2026-09-03). Node: the client's node_modules/.bin shims lack exec bits on this box, so import.sh calls Eleventy via node directly.
